title: Room Six Came With a Polite STRANGER 🛎️
premise: At this motel every review card comes true, and you get whatever the last guest wrote: our card says the man in the closet is very polite.
twist: The man was the last guest, kept in Room Six by a card that said he never left; when I write him out, the card he leaves behind is about my dad and me.
world: A bright roadside motel in the desert sun: mint doors, a pink office, a bucket for a pool, and Room Six with two orange beds, a desk with a drawer of review cards and a louvered closet.
